notes.title: “Claw – 60 dollars”.
notes.notes:
Hello, treasure hunter! “Claw – 60 dollars”. You will find a Black Crab near Ruby Flower. You must kill him. If you're lucky you'll get a claw. Bring it to your chest in the town. Write to the Sheriff about it. He'll give you a $ 60 Steam card. Attention! Do a screenshot when you find the claw in the sand. You must send it to Sheriff's mail and then post a screenshot on the game's Facebook page. (And don't forget to turn on the flashlight (f). Artifacts are visible only when there is light flashlight). Hurry up! The Sheriff only needs ONE claw. Be the first! The quest will be on 15 January 2020. (Time = UTC+2). Good luck. (Help – “j”)

(sheriffwanderfog@gmail.com)

Do a screenshot when you find the shell in the sand. You must send it to Sheriff's mail then post a screenshot on the game's Facebook page. And don't forget to turn on the flashlight (f). Artifacts are visible only when there is light flashlight(f). Hurry up! The Sheriff only needs ONE shell. Be the first! The quest will be on Monday 9 December 2019. (Time = UTC+2). Be careful! notes.title: Sunday Quest - "Rusty Hunter Shield"
notes.notes:
Arena in Fog is on the way to Pyramid of El Salvador. These are reefs with red crystals at the top. Around lay salt crystals. Artifacts are in the chests. Chests open with keys. Traders sell keys in the town. If you're lucky, you'll find a Rusty Hunter Shield. Bring Shield in your chest in town. Тell SheriffWanderfog about this. He will give you Steam gift card 40$ - only on Sunday 17 November 2019 (time UTC +2) . Attention! You have to take a screenshot of chest with Shield on the sand.  Then send it to Sheriff's mail. Hurry up! Only the first player who found Shield will receive a Steam card. Good luck! Don't forget to buy a bow to shoot down poisonous balls from the sky. 
 (sheriffwanderfog@gmail.com)

notes.title: Three days and $ 20.
notes.notes:
Do you want to get a $ 20 Steam card? Make a Necklace “La Vida” (craft book) in three days. Put it in your chest in town. Be the first. Tell the Sheriff about this. He will give a gift. Attention! Don't forget to send the Sheriff screenshots of crafting. Crystals are where the smokes and crystals stones. The coulombs are in the jars. Jugs lie in the bushes. Three days-November 1, November 2, November 3. (Time = UTC+2). And don't forget to turn on the flashlight (f). Artifacts are visible only when there is light flashlight.  Good luck. (Help – “j”)
                                                 (sheriffwanderfog@gmail.com)

notes.title: "Amber week".
notes.notes:
[b] "Amber week".
 Goddess Seamoon need to have three “Old coulomb Amber”.[/b] 
You have seven days to receive a gift from the Goddess. You have the book of crafting in your chest in town. You'll find artifacts in jugs in the bushes, in contraband sack - in “Valley of Geysers” and “Sandbox”. There are “sky crystals” in “Salt River”. (Map -” j “).  Put the coulombs in your cheat and tell the Sheriff. Attention! Don't forget to take screenshots of crystals on sand and box of diamonds on sack. The Sheriff will give you a gift or a Steam card. Be the first. And don't forget to turn on the flashlight (f). Artifacts are visible only when there is light flashlight.  The quest starts on 14 October 2019, the end – on 20 October 2019. (Time = UTC+2). And you must craft or buy a bow to kill poisonous flying balls. Good luck.
                                                 (sheriffwanderfog@gmail.com)

notes.notes:
Epic bow "Kulgan"! We give players who bought the game before September 10, 2019. This is the name of one of the sons of Genghis Khan. This bow has high critical damage. He can kill easily even Black crab - "Lord of the deadlands."
   You'll find a bow in "mail" on the panel of your chest.
